model_info.name: tulgryd
model_info.description: Modular tool handle with parametric geometry for mounting on tulgryd tiles
model_info.creator: Marcel Rienks

handle_diameter.description: Total outer diameter of the handle (circular cross-section)
handle_diameter.note: This is the primary driving parameter - all other dimensions are derived from this value

handle_height.description: Total height of the handle (radius of handle + arbitrary height component)
handle_height.note: Used to calculate overall height and ensure square base proportions

handle_radius.description: Radius of the circular handle grip cross-section

outer_wall_radius.description: Outer radius of grip walls (radius + 3mm offset)

base_height.description: Total vertical extrusion from bottom of base to top of grip

base_footprint.formula: Square footprint derived from outer grip perimeter
base_footprint.description: Base is square, sized to accommodate grip walls and ensure stable mounting

slope_angle.description: Backward slope angle of the handle grip - tilts away from open front
slope_angle.reason: Design intent for grip ergonomics and visual flow

base_hole_diameter_small.description: Small through-hole diameter (pierces through entire model height)
base_hole_diameter_small.reason: Mounting point for tile attachment system

base_hole_diameter_large.description: Large through-hole diameter (pierces only top section, creating countersunk effect)
base_hole_diameter_large.reason: Mounting point for tile attachment system with countersink

large_hole_offset.description: Upward extrusion offset for large hole, creating chamfered lip above top surface
large_hole_offset.reason: Creates countersunk mounting point with chamfered edge

chamfer_radius.description: Chamfer radius applied to large hole lip and model edges
chamfer_radius.reason: Design intent - smoothed edges for ergonomic grip

wall_thickness.description: Wall thickness for shelled grip section (front, sides, top)
wall_thickness.reason: Design intent for structural integrity and weight balance

grip_edge_offset.description: Distance from handle_diameter circle edge to inner grip wall

grip_section.description: Main cylindrical handle with 25-degree backward slope

base_section.description: Square base that matches handle diameter for stable mounting

hole_2.description: Large through-hole for alternative tile mounting or secondary attachment

handle_diameter_range.reason: Practical grip diameter for ergonomic tool use

handle_height_range.reason: Practical height for mounting above tiles

base_hole_clearance.description: Holes must fit within square base without intersecting edges

fusion_360_parameters.note: These parameters were used in Fusion 360 parametric modeling
fusion_360_parameters.derivation_method: All other dimensions calculated from primary parameters via Fusion 360 design intent
